evidence_text_pt: ampliar a adoção de sistemas de produção agropecuária diversificados, sustentáveis e resilientes, em 72,68 milhões de hectares.
evidence_text_en: By 2030, expand the adoption of diversified, sustainable and resilient agricultural production systems to 72.68 million hectares.
supporting_indicators_en: ["Number of hectares with adoption of Sustainable Production Systems, Practices, Products and Processes (SPSabc), with the exception of Intensive Termination (number of animals) and Animal Waste Management.", "Number of hectares of family farming units with agroecological production."]
match_rationale_en: The national target quantifies adoption of diversified, sustainable, and resilient agricultural production systems.

evidence_text_pt: Incrementar, em 10% ao ano, o valor total financiado em linhas de crédito que promovam a resiliência dos sistemas agropecuários de produção, até 2035, tendo como linha de base as análises do DFIN/SPA/MAPA para a safra 2021/22, no total de R$ 118 milhões
evidence_text_en: Increase, in 10% per year, the total amount financed on credit lines that promote the resilience of agricultural production systems, up to 2035, based on the analyses of DFIN/SPA/MAPA for the 2021 / 22 harvest, total of R$ 118 million
supporting_indicators_en: ["Annual percentage increase of the total value made available."]
match_rationale_en: The sector target increases financing for credit lines that promote resilient agricultural production systems.

evidence_text_pt: Ampliação do crédito para ações que promovam a resiliência dos sistemas agropecuários, dentro de uma abordagem integrada de paisagem
evidence_text_en: Extension of credit for actions that promote the resilience of agricultural systems, within an integrated landscape approach
supporting_resources_en: ["Programme 1144 – Sustainable Agriculture; Specific objective 0033 – Extend producer access to Rural Credit; Specific objective 0007 – Extending rural producer access to climate risk mitigation instruments; Specific objective 0036 – Extend the official information available to the society of actions that promote the increase of sustainability. Program 1191 – Family Agriculture and Agroecology; Specific objective 0321 – Improve Rural Credit, focusing on food production, agroecology and sociobiodiversity; Specific objective 0324 –Safra-Guarantee – Ensure family farmers guarantee protection of production due to crop loss; Specific objective 0325 – Promote access to Ater services for family farmers, in line with the principles of Pnater and in accordance with priority demands and strategic policies for Family Agriculture (such as productive inclusion, agroecology, economic and production autonomy, family livestock and others); Specific objective 0326 – Promote the training of Ater agents, providing the updating of knowledge and the improvement of different approaches, methods and methodologies, to qualify the services offered in accordance with Pnater principles and guidelines."]
supporting_indicators_en: ["Credit for the promotion of resilience in funded rural properties (million reais)."]
match_rationale_en: The action expands credit for agricultural-system resilience within an integrated landscape approach.

evidence_text_pt: Ampliação do uso de práticas de aquicultura mais resilientes às variações climáticas
evidence_text_en: Extension of the use of aquaculture practices that are more resilient to climate variations
supporting_resources_en: ["Programme 1144 – Sustainable Agriculture; Specific objective 0007 – Extending rural producer access to climate risk mitigation instruments; Specific objective 0036 – Extend the official information available to the society of actions that promote increased sustainability; Specific objective 0175 – Promote and expand the sustainability of agricultural production and family livestock; Specific objective 0185 – Promoting sustainable use of forests and forest production chains in agricultural production areas (in private properties); Specific Objective 0187 – Expand and diversify agricultural production and beekeeping, fruit farming and family farming, adding value to their products and services. 5801 Programme – Sustainable Fisheries and Aquaculture; Specific objective 0389 – Promoting the appreciation of national fish and increasing aquaculture production. 2303 Programme – Agricultural Research and Innovation; Specific objective 0037 – Increase the sharing, application and generation of technical-scientific knowledge to overcome the economic, social and environmental challenges of the agricultural, agroindustrial and forestry sectors; Specific objective 0038 – Expand the actions of PD & I, in partnership with agents of national and international innovation ecosystems, to face the challenges of the future of the agricultural, agroindustrial and forestry sectors."]
supporting_indicators_en: ["Sustainable aquaculture systems expanded (in production units), adoption of monitoring systems and precision techniques in aquaculture."]
match_rationale_en: The action expands aquaculture practices that are resilient to climate variability.

evidence_text_pt: Até 2031, ampliar a cobertura do Programa Fomento Rural, contemplando todos os estados com programas específicos de adaptação à mudança do clima, promovendo o acompanhamento familiar para inclusão social e produtiva, a segurança alimentar e a geração de renda
evidence_text_en: Until 2031, expand the coverage of the Rural Development Program, contemplating all states with specific programs to adapt to climate change, promoting family monitoring for social and productive inclusion, food security and income generation
match_rationale_en: The target expands climate-adaptation rural-development programmes that support productive inclusion and income generation, but does not focus on fisheries-dependent households or alternative sectors.

evidence_text_pt: Atender 1.550 famílias indígenas, quilombolas, e povos e comunidades tradicionais com projetos de etnodesenvolvimento para segurança alimentar e geração de renda, até 2027
evidence_text_en: Attend 1.550 indigenous families, quilombolas, and traditional peoples and communities with ethnodevelopment projects for food security and income generation, up to 2027
supporting_indicators_en: ["Percentage of indigenous families, quilombolas and traditional communities served with ethnodevelopment projects, in relation to the target of 1.550 families, until 2027."]
match_rationale_en: Ethnodevelopment projects support food security and income generation for traditional families, providing an indirect livelihood-diversification pathway.

evidence_text_pt: Fortalecer 293 organizações de povos indígenas, quilombolas, PCT e de agricultores/as familiares na Amazônia em práticas de geração de renda e autonomia de organizações extrativistas, até 2031
evidence_text_en: Strengthen 293 organizations of indigenous peoples, quilombolas, PCT and family farmers in the Amazon in practices of income generation and autonomy of extractive organizations, until 2031
supporting_indicators_en: ["Percentage of organizations of indigenous peoples, quilombolas, PCTs and family farmers in the Amazon in income generation and autonomy practices of strengthened extractive organizations, in relation to the goal of 293 organizations, until 2031."]
match_rationale_en: The target strengthens income generation and economic autonomy among traditional and family-producer organizations, but does not explicitly address climate-affected fishing livelihoods.

evidence_text_pt: Aprimorar a capacidade de Atenção à Saúde para garantir o atendimento dos serviços de saúde, incluindo a preparação de infraestruturas e equipes resilientes para lidar com os efeitos negativos da mudança do clima.
evidence_text_en: Improve the capacity of Health Care to ensure the care of health services, including the preparation of resilient infrastructure and teams to deal with the negative effects of climate change.
match_rationale_en: The health-sector objective explicitly prepares resilient infrastructure and teams to maintain care under climate impacts.

evidence_text_pt: Orientar e apoiar o desenvolvimento de um plano estratégico de enfrentamento da mudança do clima no setor hospitalar, com foco na adaptação da infraestrutura, segurança dos pacientes e resiliência das unidades de saúde, visando mitigar os impactos da mudança do clima, até 2026.
evidence_text_en: To guide and support the development of a strategic plan to cope with climate change in the hospital sector, focusing on adapting the infrastructure, patient safety and resilience of health units, aiming to mitigate the impacts of climate change, until 2026.
supporting_resources_en: ["Program 5118 - Specialized Health Care; Program 5123 – Health and Environment Surveillance; 8535 – Structure of specialized health care units."]
match_rationale_en: The action supports a hospital-sector climate plan covering infrastructure adaptation, patient safety, and resilient health units.

evidence_text_pt: Assegurar a resiliência do Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS) frente aos eventos climáticos extremos, até 2031, em 100% dos territórios mais vulneráveis à mudança do clima: Priorizando grupos vulneráveis e vulnerabilizados, em particular Povos e Comunidades Tradicionais, povos indígenas, quilombolas e periféricos; garantindo a integralidade da atenção à saúde em seus diferentes níveis – primária, secundária e terciária – bem como na vigilância e na promoção da saúde, em especial em áreas com populações vulneráveis e vulnerabilizadas; assegurando a conectividade e gestão dos sistemas de informações de saúde; garantindo a operacionalização de: Rede de Atenção à Saúde; Rede de Frio do Programa Nacional de Imunizações; Rede de Laboratórios do SUS; Assistência Farmacêutica (Básica, Estratégica e Especializada); Telessaúde; Complexo Econômico Industrial da Saúde (CEIS)
evidence_text_en: Ensure the resilience of the Unified Health System (SUS) against extreme climate events, up to 2031, in 100% of the territories most vulnerable to climate change: Prioritizing vulnerable and vulnerable groups, in particular Traditional Peoples and Communities, indigenous peoples, quilombolas and peripherals; ensuring comprehensive health care at its different levels – primary, secondary and tertiary – as well as health surveillance and promotion, especially in areas with vulnerable and vulnerable populations; ensuring connectivity and management of health information systems; ensuring the operationalization of: Health Care Network; Cold Network of the National Immunization Program; Network of laboratories of SUS; Pharmaceutical Assistance (Basic, Strategic and Specialized); Telehealth; Industrial Economic Complex of Health (CEIS)
supporting_indicators_en: ["% of priority municipalities covered by the strategy to strengthen the capacity of preparation, surveillance and response to Public Health Emergencies caused by extreme climatic events;% of territories more vulnerable to climate change prepared to act in climate emergency;% of vulnerable or vulnerable population with guaranteed care in climate emergencies; Proportion of health units in areas affected by extreme climatic events that remain operational, by health region."]
match_rationale_en: The target requires SUS resilience against extreme climate events in all territories identified as most vulnerable.

evidence_text_pt: Estabelecer diretrizes e medidas para a infraestrutura, equipes e procedimentos de saúde para garantir a continuidade das ações e serviços de saúde em eventos climáticos extremos, implementandoas em todas as regiões do país, até 2031
evidence_text_en: Establish guidelines and measures for infrastructure, teams and health procedures to ensure continuity of health actions and services in extreme climate events, implementing in all regions of the country, until 2031
match_rationale_en: The target covers infrastructure, teams, procedures, and continuity of health services during extreme climate events in every region.

evidence_text_pt: Ampliar a capacidade produtiva, provendo 200 mil tecnologias eficientes de captação e armazenamento de água, até 2035, promovendo práticas sustentáveis e resilientes à mudança do clima
evidence_text_en: Expanding productive capacity by providing 200 thousand efficient water capture and storage technologies, up to 2035, promoting sustainable and climate-resilient practices
supporting_indicators_en: ["Indicator 1 – Number of low-income rural families that have adopted tanks, underground dams, treatment and reuse systems, among other systems/technologies for capturing, storing or irrigation of low consumption for sustainable productive activities. Indicator 2 – Number of families who received training and training on techniques and practices for the management and sustainable use of water for food production using adjusted/adapted material."]
match_rationale_en: The target provides 200,000 efficient water-capture and storage technologies for climate-resilient production.

evidence_text_pt: Implementar tecnologias sociais e outros sistemas eficientes de captação e armazenamento de água ou irrigação de baixo consumo para a produção de alimentos.
evidence_text_en: Implement social technologies and other efficient systems of water collection and storage or low consumption irrigation for food production.
supporting_resources_en: ["5133 Programme – Food and Nutrition Security and Fight against Hunger Specific objective 0370 – Extend access to water for consumption and production for rural families of the Single Registry, through the implementation of social water storage technologies. Delivery 0816 - Social technologies for access to water for consumption and production."]
match_rationale_en: The action implements efficient water collection and storage systems for food production.

evidence_text_pt: Implementar tecnologias sociais e outros sistemas individuais e coletivos eficientes de captação, armazenamento e distribuição de água para consumo.
evidence_text_en: Implement social technologies and other efficient individual and collective systems to capture, store and distribute water for consumption.
supporting_resources_en: ["5133 Programme – Food and Nutrition Security and Fight against Hunger Specific objective 0370 – Extend access to water for consumption and production for rural families of the Single Registry, through the implementation of social water storage technologies. Delivery 0816 - Social technologies for access to water for consumption and production."]
match_rationale_en: The action implements individual and collective systems to capture, store, and distribute water for consumption.

evidence_text_pt: Fomentar tecnologias sociais de conservação de água em microbacias, a exemplo das Barragens de Base Zero, a partir de linhas de financiamento, implementação das tecnologias, parcerias locais, manuais, capacitações, entre outras.
evidence_text_en: Fostering social water conservation technologies in microbasins, such as Zero Base Dams, from financing lines, technology implementation, local partnerships, manuals, training, among others.
supporting_resources_en: ["Program 2321 – Water Resources; Specific Objective 0054 – Preserve, conserve and recover watersheds, especially those in vulnerable situations."]
match_rationale_en: The action supports microbasin water-conservation structures through finance, implementation, partnerships, and training.

evidence_text_pt: Implementar 26 projetos de irrigação com energia renovável e 110 projetos de sistemas produtivos sustentáveis, com irrigação localizada e reaproveitamento de água, até 2031
evidence_text_en: Implement 26 irrigation projects with renewable energy and 110 sustainable production systems projects, with localized irrigation and water reuse, up to 2031
supporting_indicators_en: ["Percentage of renewable energy irrigation projects and sustainable production systems implemented, in relation to the 136 target projects (26 of renewable energy irrigation and 110 with localized irrigation, water reuse and photovoltaic technologies), up to 2031."]
match_rationale_en: The target quantifies localized-irrigation and water-reuse projects for family farming.

evidence_text_pt: Implementar sistemas produtivos sustentáveis com irrigação localizada, reaproveitamento de água e uso de tecnologias de energia renovável, como sistemas fotovoltaicos, em propriedades da agricultura familiar
evidence_text_en: Implement sustainable productive systems with localized irrigation, reuse of water and use of renewable energy technologies, such as photovoltaic systems, in family farming properties
match_rationale_en: The action implements localized irrigation and water reuse in family-farming production systems.

evidence_text_pt: Disponibilizar formação e assistência técnica aos aquicultores familiares de localidades mais sensíveis aos efeitos da mudança do clima, com foco na aquicultura sustentável e no uso eficiente da água.
evidence_text_en: To provide training and technical assistance to family fish farmers in locations more sensitive to the effects of climate change, focusing on sustainable aquaculture and the efficient use of water.
supporting_resources_en: ["5801 Programme – Sustainable Fisheries and Aquaculture Specific objective 0389 - Promoting the appreciation of national fish and increasing aquaculture production. Delivery 1081 - Technical assistance and fishing extension for artisanal fishing."]
match_rationale_en: The action provides technical assistance on water-efficient sustainable aquaculture in climate-sensitive locations.

evidence_text_pt: Aumentar o reúso de água e reduzir a captação hídrica de mananciais na indústria nacional, até 2035
evidence_text_en: Increase water reuse and reduce water capture in national industry, up to 2035
supporting_indicators_en: ["Annual percentage of reuse water in the national industry in relation to total water consumed (%). Annual percentage of water capture of industries from sources (%)."]
match_rationale_en: The target increases industrial water reuse and reduces abstraction through 2035.

evidence_text_pt: Fomentar Sistemas de Reciclagem e Reúso de Água para uso industrial, incluindo as atividades minerais
evidence_text_en: Fomenting Water Recycling and Reuse Systems for industrial use, including mineral activities
match_rationale_en: The action promotes industrial and mining water recycling and reuse systems.

evidence_text_pt: Ampliar a segurança hídrica por meio da revitalização de bacias hidrográficas e do acesso a água em quantidade e qualidade.
evidence_text_en: To increase water safety through the revitalization of watersheds and access to water in quantity and quality.
match_rationale_en: The water-resources objective explicitly links water security to watershed revitalization and reliable water quality and quantity.

evidence_text_pt: Identificar áreas prioritárias para revitalização e recuperação de bacias hidrográficas, considerando os cenários climáticos e priorizando áreas de interesse para proteção de mananciais utilizados para o abastecimento público (PNRH, Programa 1, Ação 1.4.5 e 1.5.1).
evidence_text_en: Identify priority areas for revitalization and recovery of river basins, considering climate scenarios and prioritizing areas of interest for protection of sources used for public supply (PNRH, 1 Program, 1.4 Action. 5 and 1.5. 1).
supporting_resources_en: ["Program 2321 – Water Resources; Specific Objective 0054 – Preserve, conserve and recover watersheds, especially those in vulnerable situations."]
match_rationale_en: The action identifies priority basins for recovery and sources used for public supply for protection under climate scenarios.

evidence_text_pt: Elaborar, implementar e monitorar projetos de recuperação de Áreas de Preservação Permanente (APP) e áreas úmidas, e promover a conservação dos solos das áreas adjacentes, considerando áreas prioritárias para proteção de mananciais utilizados para o abastecimento público e área de recarga de aquífero em parceria com entes públicos e privados (PNRH, Programa 4, Ação 4.2.3).
evidence_text_en: Develop, implement and monitor projects to recover Permanent Preservation Areas (APP) and wetlands, and promote soil conservation in adjacent areas, considering priority areas for the protection of sources used for public supply and aquifer recharge area in partnership with public and private entities (PNRH, 4 Program, Action 4.2. 3).
supporting_resources_en: ["Program 2321 – Water Resources; Specific Objective 0054 – Preserve, conserve and recover watersheds, especially those in vulnerable situations; Delivery 0991 – Implementation of water and soil conservation actions – Water Producer Program; Delivery 1614 – Implementation of hydroenvironmental recovery projects of watersheds by Codevasf; MIN 076 D – Improving satellite monitoring of Brazilian watersheds; MIN 0739 – Implantation of Information System on the Revitalization of Water Basins."]
match_rationale_en: The action implements and monitors wetland, protected-area, soil, source-water, and aquifer-recharge restoration projects.

evidence_text_pt: Estabelecer uma estrutura de governança nacional das ações de revitalização de bacias hidrográficas no país, com vistas a gerar coordenação e direcionamento a essas ações, com ampla participação social, incluindo as comunidades vulneráveis, concessionárias de água e esgoto, setor público e sociedade civil.
evidence_text_en: Establish a national governance structure of river basin revitalization actions in the country, with a view to generating coordination and targeting these actions, with broad social participation, including vulnerable communities, water and sewage concessionaires, public sector and civil society.
supporting_resources_en: ["Program 2321 – Water Resources; Specific Objective 0054 – Preserve, conserve and recover watersheds, especially those in vulnerable situations."]
match_rationale_en: The action establishes national participatory governance for river-basin revitalization.

evidence_text_pt: Implementar projetos de revitalização de bacias hidrográficas para aumentar a cobertura vegetal e melhorar a infiltração de água para mitigar inundações, erosões, alagamentos e enxurradas e melhorar a qualidade da água (Projetos de revitalização apoiados / 2027: 10; 2031: 30; 2035: 50 / SNH-MIDR).
evidence_text_en: Implement river basin revitalization projects to increase vegetation cover and improve water infiltration to mitigate floods, erosions, floods and floods and improve water quality (supported revitalization projects / 2027: 10; 2031: 30; 2035: 50 / SNH-MIDR).
supporting_resources_en: ["Program 2318 – Risk and Disaster Management; Program 2321 – Water Resources; Specific Objective 0054 – Preserve, conserve and recover watersheds, especially those in vulnerable situations."]
match_rationale_en: The action implements quantified basin-revitalization projects to improve infiltration, flood resilience, erosion control, and water quality.
